iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear risk edges higher: IAEA-linked reports say Kazakhstan could hold Iran enriched uranium under a deal, Reuters says Tehran highly enriched uranium remains its core bargaining card, and Netanyahu says the Iran war is not over until the stockpile is removed. Declared 60 percent enrichment remains the standing technical driver; top-level enrichment jump and device event absent.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Iran/Gulf conventional risk remains imminent and slightly firmer: Jerusalem Post/i24/MEE/Haaretz report UAE airstrikes coordinated with the US and Israel, while Crisis Group analysis keeps Strait of Hormuz disruption scenarios central. Negotiation chatter persists but is outweighed by active strike and maritime-risk reporting.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon remains the sharpest regional conventional flashpoint: Reuters reported Israeli forces crossed a key Lebanon river in an expanded ground offensive, Al Jazeera reported 14 killed in Israeli attacks, and Lebanon withdrawal demands were rejected while talks have not halted strikes.

turkey.name: TURKEY / EAST MED
turkey.notes: Turkey/East Mediterranean remains deterrent: current feeds are mostly analysis and older posture pieces about maritime strategy, NATO balancing, and regional rivalry. No fresh direct interstate clash, official atomic warning, or force surge crossed the dashboard threshold.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan sits at high elevated: WION, Republic, Daily Jagran and 24 News HD reported the Indian army chief warning Pakistan that forces are ready for Operation Sindoor 2.0. No fresh cross-border strike was confirmed in this scan, but rhetoric and readiness signaling intensified.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO remains imminent by spillover and strategic-warning context: current scan carried Romanian drone-hit fallout and European warning coverage from Ukraine spillover feeds, with broader nuclear intimidation context unchanged. No confirmed direct NATO-Russia combat exchange surfaced.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains elevated but below critical: available feeds were mostly earlier 2026 military-activity tracking and Taiwan exercise analysis, not a fresh blockade or crisis-level surge in this scan.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea remains critical: South Korea accused the North of firing an unidentified projectile and feeds reported AI-guided cruise missiles and ballistic rockets near South Korea. Atomic detonation absent; projectile activity is the active driver.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine/NATO spillover remains the top systemic driver: current feeds reported Putin saying the war is near its end while Medvedev warned Europe, and multiple outlets flagged the Romanian drone incident as alarming NATO. Spillover plus strategic rhetoric keeps the probability imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan rose within critical: Google News feeds carried reports that Taliban forces seized multiple Pakistani army outposts along the Durand Line, with additional coverage of regional military alignment around Taliban-Pakistan tensions. Formal diplomacy signals are weaker than the border-fighting risk.

sudan.name: SUDAN / RED SEA SPILLOVER
sudan.notes: Sudan/Red Sea spillover carries forward at critical-low: no stronger fresh hard-conflict trigger was found in this scheduled scan, but external-backing and force-posture risks remain active from prior assessment.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE / GAZA
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza risk remains imminent by carry-forward: expanded-control and strike reporting from the prior scan remains the active driver, with weak political off-ramp and continuing force-use risk.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated by residual instability; no fresh clash trigger was found in this scheduled scan.
